evidence: Pins recovered 2026-11-24 by disassembling the stock flash dump (SWire read, local backup/stock_1.bin, not published), using Telink 8258 SDK driver signatures; see docs/HARDWARE.md 'Stock firmware analysis'. Confirmed 2026-11-24/25 with the --hw-test bench image: SHTC3 on PC0/PC1 reads plausible T/RH, button PB6 idle 1 / held 0, LED PD2 toggles, probe on PB4 with PD3 power + PWM2 on PC4 reads ~2720 mV in air and reacts to touch, settle sweep follows an RC curve (tau ~18 ms). Light sensor PB5 reads 0 (also on stock firmware; likely not fitted).
th_sensor: SHTC3 at I2C 0x70 (SDA PC0, SCL PC1; stock firmware bit-bangs it)
stock_pwm: PWM2 on PC4, 100 kHz (480 ticks at 48 MHz), 50 % duty
stock_debug_uart: PC2 software UART TX, ~1 Mbaud; hardware UART PB1 (TX) / PB7 (RX)
